fields.value: Rent RunPod CPU machines for jobs and release them when done

Evaluations are CPU work: many single-threaded game workers, no GPU. The launcher already rents machines for a cohort of runs and releases each one when no waiting run fits it, with the guardian deleting any machine at its paid deadline. But the RunPod provider only rents GPU pods: a pool whose template names no GPU is refused at the first rental (`providers/runpod/machines.py:32`). So "rent machines to run these evals and release them when they're done" cannot use cheap CPU machines.

Outcome: a pool whose machine template names no GPU rents RunPod CPU pods, priced and capped like GPU pods, through the same rent, take-waiting-runs, terminate-when-done and deadline path.

Acceptance:

* `etude pool add cpu --provider runpod --vcpus 8 --memory-gb 16 --max 2 --max-usd-per-hour 0.40`, then `etude launch job.py --pool cpu --cohort cpu-smoke --parallel 2 --max-usd 1` and `etude wait`: two runs complete on two CPU pods, logs are retained, and both pods are deleted when no run fits, before their deadlines.
* No new provider or duplicated create/billing/delete path; `gpu=None` means CPU.
* A counting test pins provider calls for one CPU rental.
* Live smoke on RunPod passes before review. Allowance: $5 of RunPod spend; report spent and remaining. No account information in the repo.
* Gate: `uv run pytest`, `uv run mypy`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`.

Design: `scratch/runpod-cpu-pods.md` (draft), follow-up of the eval-runs design (`scratch/eval-runs.md`, PRs #17 and #18). Independent of those PRs; branch from main.
